purpose.summary: Time-stamps and sequences all regime transitions; projects substrate depletion timelines; generates domain chronology for DDR.
purpose.detail: The TSEQ receives time-stamped signals from the Drift Sentinel and Stability Basin Cartographer and constructs a complete temporal model of regime transitions — recording when each transition occurred, its duration, its velocity trajectory, and its substrate runway impact. The TSEQ also projects forward: given current drift velocity and substrate depletion rate, it estimates the timeline to: (a) first faultline activation, (b) coherence floor breach, (c) basin saturation, and (d) regime collapse. These projections are included in the DDR's Domain Chronology section.
